messages:
Alex Chen: FYI preparing to promote PR #4235 -> overlay/staging -> overlay/prod. Main changes: move secret paths from /staging/apps/ to /secrets/services/, add a kustomize patch to update serviceAccount annotation for KMS alias, and a small Terraform rename. Can someone eyeball for release gating? Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4235 :eyes:

Jenkins CI: terraform plan completed for infra/staging
```diff
- data.aws_secretsmanager_secret_version.old
+ resource.aws_secretsmanager_secret.new
```
No destructive changes expected but name change will create a new secret version.

Meera Singh: If we create new secret versions we need a re-encryption step + pods that mount them need to pick up the new version. How will the rotation be handled? :thinking: 

Alex Chen: Plan is to keep old versions live and write new secret at `/secrets/services/<svc>` then update k8s Secret by patch; pods will restart on rollout. We're not deleting the old path.

Samira Patel: Quick review - kustomize patch looks fine but we should preserve `metadata.finalizers` on the Secret to avoid GC during transition. Add that to the patch.

Jordan Park: Recommend a canary as part of the promote: pin image digest and route 10% traffic for 30m with the rollout policy in Console. If healthy, promote to 100%.

Meera Singh: Also confirm KMS behaviour — are we swapping an alias or provisioning a new key? If alias swap, that can affect decrypts during the window; coord with security.

Alex Chen: We're provisioning a new key, alias `alias/rwd-prod-2024-rot`. Security already signed off (see #eng-security). I'll add a note to the PR.

Samira Patel: LGTM with finalizer + canary. I'll approve the PR once those are added. @alexchen please add a short migration runbook snippet in the PR description.

Alex Chen: Added runbook to PR and included the minimal commands to patch the secret and restart the deployment. Snippet: 
```bash
kubectl patch secret svc-config -n prod --patch '{"metadata":{"annotations":{"secretsync":"pending"}}}'
# wait for controller to reconcile
kubectl rollout restart deploy/my-svc -n prod
```

Oncall Bot: Scheduling oncall window 2024-06-12T03:00Z for 2h for the promote. No planned downtime but please monitor token fetch errors and SecretsController logs.

Samira Patel: I'll be oncall during the promote. :thumbsup:

Meera Singh: One more ask — add an env fallback to read from `SECRETS_FALLBACK_PATH` if the new path is missing to prevent crashes on partial rollout.

Alex Chen: Done, pushed small patch to add fallback env + retry logic. Re-running CI.

Jenkins CI: plan/apply started -> apply completed ✅

Jordan Park: OK let's execute a staged promote tomorrow morning. I'll coordinate the canary, watch metrics (error rate, token fetch latency), and have rollback steps ready.

Samira Patel: Thanks all, will watch the rollout and verify finalizers are preserved. :rocket:
